eval-q09.about: What is the mineral resource estimate for the Iron Lake property?
eval-q09.reason: Searched all seven reports for "mineral resource estimate", "NI 43-101 resource tonnes grade indicated inferred", "million tonnes", "reserves", "historical estimate" and "economic ore body delineated tonnage". Every tonnage/grade or resource figure found is for a different property or deposit: Woodjam (Southeast, Deerhorn, Takom zones; 36430 p17, 36807 p19), the Aguablanca mine in Spain, and other Cu-Ni deposits used for comparison (34595 p13, p16; 36430 p16; 36807 p18). None of the reports states a mineral resource or reserve estimate for Iron Lake itself. Report 34595 p9 says an economic ore body could be developed "if one was delineated on the Iron Lake property", which does not give an estimate.

eval-q10.query: propylitic green rock chlorite epidote mineral chemistry vectoring
recommended future work age dating epidote chlorite analyses

eval-q10.about: What did the 2025 geochronology and green rock study on the Iron Lake property find?
eval-q10.reason: Searched for "geochronology" (no hits), "green rock study", "2025 U-Pb zircon age dating", "2025 program work summary", "propylitic green rock chlorite epidote mineral chemistry vectoring" and "recommended future work age dating epidote chlorite analyses". The newest report, 41800, describes the 2023 program (an airborne Xcite HTDEM survey and 3 core holes) according to its summary on p.8 and its table of contents on p.6. In these reports, "2025" shows up only as claim expiry dates (e.g. 40980 p.15). The age dates that are given (e.g. an Ar-Ar age of 187.7 ±1.1 Ma) come from earlier published regional work by Schiarizza and Boulton. They are not from a 2025 study. None of the seven reports describes a 2025 geochronology or green rock study.

eval-q11.about: What metallurgical recoveries have been reported for Iron Lake mineralization?
eval-q11.reason: I searched all seven reports for "metallurgical" (no hits), "metallurgical recovery", "metallurgical testwork flotation concentrate recovery", "Davis tube magnetic separation", "metallurgy bench scale test leach", "recoveries percent concentrate grade", "mineral processing metallurgical study", "recovered magnetite iron ore test" and "mill grinding testing sample concentrate". The only "recovery" hits are drill core recovery and RQD logging (41327 p30, 41800 p35). The resource figures I found (36430 p17, 36807 p19) are for other deposits' zones, not Iron Lake. No report states a metallurgical test or recovery for Iron Lake mineralization.

eval-q12.about: What grades did drill hole IL-22-099 return?
eval-q12.reason: I searched for 'IL-22-099', 'IL22-099' and '099' in all seven reports and got no hits. Report 41327 says the 2022 program was 23 holes (p.29). Its Table 2 (p.30) lists holes IL-22-001 to IL-22-023, and its Table 3 of significant intervals (p.33) has no hole IL-22-099. I also checked the 2023 drilling in report 41800 and found no hole by that name. No report gives this hole or any grades for it.
